messages:
maggie.marketing: Morning team — new draft of the post is up (v1.0). Need a fast editorial pass, legal signoff, UTMs for the three CTAs, and confirmation on webinar/demo flow. Doc: https://docs.example/launch-v1 :mag_right:

tori.copy: reading now. Headline feels long; propose a one-line hero then a 2-sentence kicker. Also move the customer quote into the second paragraph to lead with outcomes.

devon.growth: CTA buckets we need: 'Start hosted trial', 'Request Dedicated trial', 'Book enterprise pilot'. Proposed utm_content values: hosted_trial, dedicated_trial, enterprise_pilot. Will need distinct UTM content to route into different nurture flows.

nate.ops: UTM pattern I suggest:
```
utm_campaign=may_launch_2026
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PILOT
```
I'll create CRM mappings once you confirm exact content strings.

elaine.legal: Quick legal notes: remove absolute comparative language (e.g., "lowest" or "best"). Add a short data controls line: "Supports SOC2, optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), and configurable retention." After that I can approve.

tori.copy: removed superlatives and added the KMS/HSM line. Also shortened hero to one sentence + 2-line kicker and moved the quote up.

rory.events: Webinar proposed: Tue May 12 2026, 16:00 UTC. Recommend reserving 10 live demo slots + a waitlist form. I can draft calendar copy (two lines) once publish date is locked.

devon.growth: Sales ask: anyone who clicks enterprise_pilot and views /pricing should be flagged as PQL. Nate, can you add a simple workflow for that?

nate.ops: Yes — will add a tracking pixel on /pricing and a rule: if utm_content=enterprise_pilot AND visited_pricing => tag: blog_enterprise_pql and assign to AE queue.

maggie.marketing: timeline: Tori finish copy edits by 14:00 UTC, Elaine legal signoff by 15:00, Devon confirm UTMs by 15:15, Rory lock invites. If all green we'll queue embargo for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC.

publish-bot: Reminder: embargo candidate set for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: after final approvals.

maggie.marketing: one more item — do we embed the benchmark chart or link to an appendix? Embedding might slow load.

devon.growth: link to appendix and include a one-line takeaway in-body. We'll publish the full deck separately for partners.

tori.copy: linked appendix and added: "See benchmark appendix for methodology and full results." Left a placeholder: "~Y% lower per-token cost" to fill after performance QA.

elaine.legal: approved the copy after the above edits. No further comments.

rory.events: locked 10 demo slots and created the signup form: https://forms.example/demo-signup. Calendar blurb: "Launch + live demo — 30-min product walkthrough, 15-min Q&A. Reserve a demo slot after the webinar."

maggie.marketing: great — final checklist: confirm the utm_content strings (Devon), legal reaction (Elaine), and publish-bot embed. If all :white_check_mark: we lift embargo tomorrow AM. Thanks all!
